name: Altissima
overview: Altissima is the crowning achievement of Al Barari Dubai, the visionary developer behind the entire Al Barari community. This exclusive development offers only 23 standalone 7-bedroom villas, each meticulously crafted and spanning four luxurious floors. Surrounded by lush greenery, Altissima combines opulence, sustainability, and comfort, promising an unparalleled living experience.
